{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
penguins = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Display the first few rows
print(penguins.head())

# Check for missing values
print("Missing values:")
print(penguins.isnull().sum())

# Check unique species
types = penguins['species'].unique()
print(f"Unique species: {types}")

# Check for duplicates
print(f"Number of duplicate rows: {penguins.duplicated().sum()}")

# Check flipper length distribution
print("Flipper length summary:")
print(penguins['flipper_length_mm'].describe())"}
